item.title: Samsung's Processing-in-Memory (PIM)
item.description:
📝 DRAM chips are internally divided into banks, each with their own read and write logic. Because the chip is in multi-bank mode, each PIM register write gets broadcast across all 16 banks. Each DRAM packet is 256 bits (BL=16) Filling each source register takes 16 write commands.
🔗 Read more: https://chipsandcheese.com/p/hot-chips-2026-samsungs-processing
